name: AWS Knowledge MCP Server
summary: A managed remote MCP server from AWS that searches and reads AWS documentation, API references, What's New posts, Well-Architected guidance, CDK and CloudFormation references, regional availability data and AWS agent skills. The vendor says it needs no AWS account and no authentication, at no cost, under rate limits; measured true for initialize, tools/list and a search call.

agentAccess.notes: Keyless from a cloud IP. 2026-09-11 23:06Z: initialize 200 (AWSKnowledgeMCP 1.0.0), tools/list 200 with five tools, search_documentation 200. 2026-09-20 06:03Z: initialize and tools/list, same five. 2026-09-24 06:10Z: initialize only. Tool names carry an aws___ prefix the README omits.

payments.notes: Read 2026-09-24. One price statement, the GA post: "The server is publicly accessible at no cost and does not require an AWS account." The server page speaks to authentication and rate limits, not price. Nothing prices a call; nothing answered a 402. Rate limits published as no number.

jobs.summary: AWS documentation, API references, code samples, troubleshooting guides, Well-Architected guidance, CDK and CloudFormation references and Strands Agents SDK docs, searched and read into an agent's context over a hosted MCP server; the vendor's claim, retrieval quality not measured.
